backpressure.policy: every stalled domain releases within its bounded period; permanent stalls are not used

required_scenarios: exact WED target and progress publication
command legality for every issued read and write
reset in flight followed by a clean rerun
every configuration word bit driven with the CU idle
a round with the AFU read buffer almost full
a ring graph with more vertices than the top has graph CUs
graph-top.precision_policy: transaction level: completion, WED progress, command legality and no dropped or duplicated commands

sensitivity.policy: mutations are declared per context in suites.json
